name: Five Keys Schools and Programs
description: Free high school diploma, GED/HiSET prep, and workforce programs for adults, including justice-involved people
fullDescription: Five Keys is a nonprofit charter school and organization offering free adult education (high school diploma, GED, HiSET) to Californians ages 16 and up, with a focus on people affected by incarceration, plus workforce and reentry programs.
whatTheyOffer:
- Free high school diploma programs
- GED and HiSET preparation
- College Pathways program
- Workforce development and transitional employment
- Classes at 70+ teaching sites, including county jails and community locations
- Wraparound support services
howToGetIt:
1. Contact Five Keys at 415-734-3310 or through the website
2. Open to anyone 16 or older living in California
3. Complete enrollment and intake
4. Attend classes at a community site or program location
5. Receive supportive services while you study
keywords: Five Keys, free high school diploma, GED, HiSET, adult education, formerly incarcerated, reentry, justice-involved, workforce development, San Francisco, Oakland
